Name: Eskbl-esque Vanilla Older Wizard (RRRR and SVE)
Author: FreakyBiscuit1
Description:
I've been a little obssessed with  [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/16893]RRRR[/url], but I wanted something in the vanilla style, so decided to make my own. 
Heavily inspired by [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/7529]Eskbl's Wizard Portrait[/url], thank you so much for the permission to adapt!

This is made specifically for [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/3753]SVE[/url] and  [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/16893]RRRR[/url] , with the full 32-set expressions for RRRR. 
This whole page is kind of a WIP for whenever I have the time, but wanted to get this man out there. Currently working on overworld sprites to match, but for now, use [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/22691?tab=description&BH=3]Wizard Sprites for Eskbl's Portraits[/url]!
[line]
[b][u]How to Install:[/u][/b]
[list]
[*]Go to 'Stardew Valley > Mods > Portraiture > Portraits' [/*]
[*]Unzip 'Vanilla Razzy (SVE or RRRR, depending on what you have)' and drop the folder into 'Portraits'[/*]
[*]Start the game and talk to the Wizard, once his dialogue box is open, press 'P' to toggle portraits. [/*]
[/list][line]
[b]Note: If you are interested in adapting the assets of this mod, please contact me first. I'm happy to work with you! I do not permit any assets to be used with AI generation in any form.  [/b]

Downloads.Description: 32-expression set for RRRR! Be sure to have all of the required downloads for RRRR before use!
This is for if you play with SVE only (no RRRR)
